$doc: Footer's appearance, as data — the source of the `@component footer` block in css/components.css and of dist/react/footer.tsx. Same contract as components/button/definition.json: a plain string is a structural literal, {"token": "x"} binds --x, and an array is a sequence of both. Footer is the first block outside the R1 pilot to generate, and it is the case that added `aside`: two of its declarations carry a remark that qualifies the value without deserving four lines above the rule. It has no variants, no sizes, no states and no parts — one selector, one rule, which is why it was in the audit's generatable-now column with no schema growth beyond that one comment form.

declarations.aside: was its own clamp, one 0.5rem cap away from --pad's — identical below 1600px, so it was never a decision
not chrome-border-strong: a border token read as text, which inverts to 2.7:1 in dark
